critical_questions: What specific circumstances or timeline led to this public announcement now, and why was the dissolution only formally announced after the court decision?

articles.title: Respond To Suit On NYSC Records, Court Orders Minister
articles.summary: Justice Salim Ibrahim of the Federal High Court sitting in Abuja has directed the minister of Interior, Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, to respond to a suit seeking to compel the release of records of his National Youth Service Corps (NYSC). The court gave the order on Monday, when the matter came up. The minister is expected to […]
